T-shirt noun

Traupman 389
Plaut.

tunicula, tuniculae f.

noun, first declension

Classically a little tunic.

Other words

  • camīsula

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. shirt: t-shirt

  • camisiola

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. shirt: t-shirt

  • camisia levis

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. shirt: t-shirt

    Morgan–Owens’s camisia (Jerome) and indūsium are post-classical in this sense.

Examples

  • Hodiē calet: tuniculam et brācās curtās indue.

    It’s hot today: put on a T-shirt and shorts.composed

See also shirt, shorts, short-sleeved, long-sleeved, sleeveless.
